Input image 1 is the authoritative PRODUCT and COLOR reference: preserve its watch identity, exact case shape and proportions, digital crown, side button, display design, case finish, strap shape, smooth silicone material, pin-and-tuck closure and real color pairing. Input image 2 is STYLE/COMPOSITION ONLY: use its pale icy-blue studio wall, soft diagonal window-light stripes, glossy white tabletop with subtle natural reflection and three-quarter upright watch composition. Subject: Apple Watch Series 11, matte medium gray aluminum case and matte charcoal black smooth silicone Sport Band; blue luminous rounded numerals watch face exactly like reference 1.

The whole watch including top and bottom of band fits completely with at least 8 percent clear margin at top and bottom. Preserve source geometry and screen appearance. Crisp product details and naturally rounded glass, realistic soft shadows. Color-calibrated neutral product lighting: pale-blue background must NOT tint the product. Background reaches all edges. No frame, no border, no product text outside display, no logo overlay, no extra objects. No textile, mesh, woven, metal bracelet or buckle strap; smooth silicone Sport Band only.
